ui.agents.detail.install.action.install_.note: The read-only (built-in) agent's one action: installs a copy you can edit. It is the point of the button, so do not shorten it to a bare 'Install'. The alert above says the same thing in a sentence.

ui.agents.detail.install.action.installi.note: Replaces install_to_edit while the install runs; kept to one word plus the ellipsis so the row does not jump. U+2026, not three dots (the same rule as saving).
ui.agents.detail.install.action.installi.role: button label while the install is in flight
